meta.title: Side chat
meta.description: Right-click a text selection in a chat to get two actions: "Quote in current chat" inserts a Markdown blockquote into the current composer without sending, and "Ask in side chat" forks the conversation into a real child Session and opens its Chat in a tab on the right sidebar. The child Session stays in the session list and inherits the parent's history as reference context. The selected text is prefilled into the child draft as a blockquote; the developer boundary is delivered as a hidden system-prompt section on forked Sessions, so nothing is sent automatically: only pressing Enter starts a model request, which may include tool calls. Closing the tab does not delete the child Session, and disabling the bundle removes all entries. Unlike Codex, the child is a normal persistent Session and the boundary applies to every non-subagent fork. v2 batch A adds a /side command, a right-Sidebar guide capsule and home page, a recent-side-chats list that reopens closed tabs side-by-side, a nesting-depth limit and a truncation note. Batch B moves the developer boundary into the Host half as a hidden prompt section (durable across restarts), adds a Config schema, and renames the Host row to side-chat-v2. Changing Host code needs remove_bundle + install_bundle (or a DSH restart); Client-only edits need the DSH window reloaded. Developed against DSH 0.2.2-rc.5.
